label: DAY 18
title: My worst bot never beat my best bot. It tied it 928 times out of 1,000.

scenes.title: Worst vs best
lines: My worst bot never beat my best one. Not once in a thousand games. But it tied it nine hundred and twenty eight times.

scenes.title: My game: Trail Duel

items.text: Both move at the same time
Hit a wall or edge: crash

lines: I coded a two player game. Both riders move at the same time, and every cell they leave becomes a wall.
Crash and you lose. Last one moving wins. Step into the same cell at the same time, and it's a draw.

scenes.title: 6 bots
lines: Six bots. The chaser just drives at the other rider. Territory, my smartest, counts which cells it can reach before its rival, and takes the move with the biggest lead.

scenes.title: Losses out of 5,000 games
lines: Every pair played a thousand games. Territory lost just eighty eight out of five thousand.

scenes.title: Chaser vs Territory
lines: Against the chaser, it won only seventy two.
The rest were draws. In a rematch, every single draw was a head on crash.

scenes.label: games that ended head-on, all 15,000
scenes.sub: half of every game I ran
lines: Across all fifteen thousand games, seven thousand five hundred and thirty ended head on. My bots check walls, but not where the other rider is about to step.

scenes.title: The fix: Wary
lines: So I made a fix, called Wary. Same brain, but it never steps where the other rider could also step.
Against the chaser: nine hundred and twenty four wins out of a thousand.

scenes.title: Wary vs the old bot
lines: Then I put the fix against the old version. It lost six hundred and nine of a thousand, and won only three hundred and fifty four.
Wary backed away from a shared cell three thousand eight hundred and eighty six times. Eighty three percent of the time, the old bot took that exact cell.

scenes.text: Backing off gave the cell away.
scenes.sub: Territory beats Wary. Wary beats Chaser. Chaser ties Territory. Which bot should I build next?
lines: Backing off hands the cell to the bot that doesn't. Now no bot beats all the others.
What bot should I build next? Tell me in the comments.

thumbnail.headline: My worst bot tied my best
